purpose: Select exactly one economically interpretable Campaign037 mechanism without reading a new candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

selected_concept.economic_question: Does the completed session's signed one-minute return path reinforce over a fixed five-return horizon, or cancel through short-horizon reversal?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: A higher fixed five-return variance ratio means that signed one-minute innovations reinforce at a short multiscale horizon rather than cancel. This can represent persistent information incorporation that may remain relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_concept.fixed_temporal_question: Use exactly the 240 raw unadjusted one-minute closes at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00. Form returns and demean separately inside each half, use exactly five consecutive within-half returns in every overlapping aggregate, and never cross lunch.
known_design_risks: Choosing the aggregation horizon after values would create a lag search, so the horizon is fixed at exactly five consecutive returns before values.
Overlapping five-return sums can correlate with sign runs, spectral concentration, path efficiency, or serial persistence even though the statistic retains signed covariance at a fixed scale.
Demeaning globally rather than separately by half would introduce the lunch boundary indirectly, so per-half demeaning is fixed before values.

A high ratio may reflect persistent information or transient crowding. The higher direction must remain fixed and the ordinary no-return and walk-forward gates must decide the hypothesis without inversion.

rejected_concepts.reason: Searching the aggregation horizon would add a parameter sweep after 36 completed campaigns. Campaign037 freezes exactly five consecutive returns and no alternate lag.
Absolute-return persistence and high-low range reversal are terminal. Campaign037 retains signed returns and measures multiscale variance rather than magnitude autocorrelation.
Campaign033 is terminal. Campaign037 uses no DFT, band, phase, taper, padding, or entropy and cannot rescue spectral entropy.
Sparse-update, sign-run, weak-order, and price-grid mechanisms are terminal. Campaign037 uses squared sums of continuous signed returns without equality counts or ordinal states.
Campaign037 is one own-stock close-only statistic and introduces no activity field, benchmark, event field, terminal factor value, model, or combination.

decision.next_action: Perform a separate mechanism-overlap audit and freeze the one exact formula, direction, support, missing semantics, and complete 58-factor comparison library before opening candidate or comparison values.
